name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Grzegorz Braun
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection (immunity) of Grzegorz Braun, a member elected in Poland. Polish prosecutors want to charge him over statements he made at a public debate in Warsaw on 27 September 2025. They say he denied the crimes of genocide committed at the Auschwitz-Birkenau camp. Lifting his immunity allows the Polish case to go ahead. Parliament found no sign that the case was brought to harm his political work.

- **What changes:** Braun loses his protection from prosecution in Poland, so the criminal case can proceed.
- **Who it affects:** Grzegorz Braun, a member of the European Parliament elected in Poland.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the decision to Polish authorities and to Braun.
